parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The streaming domain.
- You can specify a single domain name or multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
- If this parameter is not specified, the merged data of all live streaming domain names is returned by default.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). The end time must be later than the start time. The interval between the start time and end time cannot exceed one year.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity of the queried data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

- **300**
- **3600**
- **86400**

If this parameter is not specified or the specified value is not supported, the default value is 300 seconds when the time span does not exceed 3 days, 3600 seconds when the time span exceeds 3 days, and 86400 seconds when the time span exceeds 30 days.

parameters.name: LogStore
parameters.description: The Logstore for real-time log delivery. If this parameter is not specified, the merged data of all Logstores is returned by default.

parameters.name: Project
parameters.description: The Project for real-time log delivery. If this parameter is not specified, the merged data of all Projects is returned by default.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).
